verdict.rationale: Gemini API docs describe a dedicated safety-settings feature: developers can tune four filter categories to restrict or allow content types and set stricter or looser configurations per application. That satisfies the story's 'safety settings' guardrail primitive, and the published Prohibited Use Policy adds usage-policy context. missing for 10: no evidence of a standalone moderation/classification endpoint, no documented pattern for gating model output or function-call actions before execution, no independent or hands-on corroboration of how the safety filters behave.
